## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete problem and how this change addresses it.

## Validation

List the relevant tests, build or browser checks actually run. Note checks not run and why.

## Compatibility and limits

Describe native project/format changes, migrations and remaining limits.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The diff contains no credentials, private media, local databases or environment files.
- [ ] Credential checks passed, or a redacted finding and its resolution are explained.
- [ ] Tests use synthetic fixtures and do not make paid model calls.
- [ ] Imported assets/code have documented redistribution rights.
- [ ] Documentation reflects the implemented subset.
- [ ] Contribution/license terms are confirmed with the maintainer before public redistribution.
